recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-dimensional abstract illustration depicting a deep, swirling vortex or tunnel. The pattern is composed of alternating bands of red, black, and white, creating an optical illusion of depth and movement. The bands are of varying thickness, narrowing towards the center of the vortex, which appears as a small, bright white point. A large, dark, semi-transparent circular overlay is present in the upper left quadrant of the vortex, partially obscuring the pattern beneath it.
coreVisualRelationships: The alternating red, black, and white bands create a strong sense of rotation and depth.
The narrowing of the bands towards the center emphasizes the vortex effect.
The dark circular overlay contrasts with the vibrant spiral, suggesting an interruption or a different plane.
The overall composition is dominated by the dynamic spiral, drawing the eye inward.
The high contrast between the colors enhances the visual impact and illusion.
coreInvariants: The spiral must be composed of at least three distinct, high-contrast colors.
The bands must progressively narrow towards the center to create a sense of depth.
The overall shape must be a vortex or tunnel, implying a journey or transition.
A contrasting overlay element should be present to add complexity and a focal point outside the direct center of the spiral.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The vortex occupies the majority of the lower two-thirds of the canvas, positioned centrally but slightly skewed to the right, with its 'mouth' opening towards the lower right. The dark circular overlay is prominent in the upper left of the vortex, acting as a secondary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white center of the vortex serves as the primary visual anchor, drawing the eye into the depth of the illustration. The dark circular overlay acts as a secondary, contrasting anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is immediately drawn to the high-contrast spiral, following the swirling bands inward towards the bright center. The circular overlay then redirects attention to the upper left, creating a dynamic, circular eye path.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white background surrounding the spiral is minimal, allowing the vibrant pattern to dominate the composition. The negative space within the spiral itself is defined by the alternating colors, contributing to the illusion of depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white serve as the foundational colors, creating the primary contrast and defining the structure of the spiral.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red provides a strong, vibrant contrast to the black and white, adding energy and visual interest to the pattern.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The bright white at the very center of the vortex acts as a subtle accent, emphasizing the depth and focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The colors are highly saturated and exhibit strong value contrast (black vs. white, red vs. white/black), which is crucial for the optical illusion effect. The dark overlay introduces a lower value, creating a shadowed effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to three primary colors (red, black, white) for the main spiral.
The overlay should be a darker, desaturated version of one of the primary colors or a neutral tone.

adjustableVariables: Number of colors in the spiral (minimum 3).
Thickness and curvature of the spiral bands.
Position and size of the dark circular overlay.
Overall color palette, while maintaining high contrast.
recipe.mustRedesign: The illustration must be redesigned to ensure the optical illusion of depth and movement is immediately apparent and impactful. The color choices must be bold and contrasting to achieve this effect.

mustAchieve: A strong sense of depth and motion through the spiral pattern.
High visual contrast between the chosen colors.
A clear focal point that draws the viewer's eye.
An unsettling or intriguing visual effect.
avoid: Symmetrical or static patterns that do not convey movement.
Overly complex details that detract from the core illusion.
Soft edges or gradients that reduce the sharpness of the lines.

postGenerationChecks: Does the spiral effectively create an illusion of depth and movement?
Are the chosen colors highly contrasting and impactful?
Is the overall composition dynamic and engaging?
Does the dark overlay element contribute to the visual narrative without overpowering the spiral?
Is the central focal point clearly defined and visually compelling?
Does the image evoke a sense of disorientation or intrigue?
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a high-contrast, multi-color spiral vortex with bands that narrow towards a bright center. Introduce a large, dark, semi-transparent circular overlay in the upper left quadrant of the vortex to add a secondary visual element and disrupt the continuous spiral pattern.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: contrast (sans-serif for body/display, script for logo)

preserve: left alignment for display and body text
right alignment for small metadata text
solid black fill for sans-serif text
solid red fill for script text
avoid: serif fonts for display or body
centered alignment for main text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the robust, low-contrast, and somewhat condensed feel of the sans-serif display and body text.
Similar strong, industrial sans-serif characteristics for the display and body text.
Captures the informal, flowing, and slightly condensed nature of the script logo.
Offers a similar casual, flowing script style for the logo, though potentially less condensed.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate the full-page image with the psychedelic spiral graphic, ensuring the top portion is a solid light background (off-white/light grey) for text placement. The spiral should occupy the bottom two-thirds of the page, transitioning from a dark center to red, black, and white stripes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the sans-serif text in black on the light background in the top-left and top-right. Overlay the script text in red in the top-right, above the building illustration. Add a thin black horizontal rule below the first body text block. Add the small sans-serif caption text in black in the bottom-right of the light background area.

verificationChecks: Are the display and body texts clearly sans-serif with a consistent weight difference?
Is the logo text distinctly a script font and colored red?
Is the overall layout respecting the left-aligned blocks for main text and right-aligned for metadata?
Is the psychedelic spiral graphic the dominant visual element below the text blocks?
